k15k_interpretation: On MDLM-OWT 130M, max-grad correlates NEGATIVELY with held-out loss (rho=-0.65, p<1e-7); i.e., high max-grad cells have LOWER held-out loss. This contrasts with the paper's within-LLaDA-family claim (high max-grad on rank-amp top-decile final-loss cells). Consistent with K15e bifurcation: large pretrained DLMs (LLaDA, Dream) show rank-amp instability via max-grad; small dense DLM (MDLM-130M) shows max-grad as learning-activity proxy. Same signal indicates different regimes by model scale.
